owner_report: Booster/pickup is not visibly rendered in ordinary gameplay, for many releases, although it can be collected and the booster works.
classification: RASTER (primary) + PMG shape data (secondary, independently proven)

why_previous_proof_was_insufficient.shared_misconception: src/main.s claimed 'GTIA consumes only M0-M3 bits 4-7' and the native gate in scripts/atari800-wall-trace.h counted rows with (MEMORY_mem[0x3b00+row] & 0xf0) != 0. One missile is two bits (M0 = bits 0-1 .. M3 = bits 6-7), so the 0xf0 mask inspects only M2/M3 - exactly the half the shape data happened to set correctly. The check could only ever confirm the belief the implementation already encoded.
why_previous_proof_was_insufficient.never_a_pixel: No prior artifact sampled the rendered framebuffer for the production capsule. The PMG 'lab' screenshot injected a synthetic $F0 pattern and states it never enters the production XEX; the production screenshot artifact weapon-pickup-static-atari800.png did not exist in the tree before this task.
why_previous_proof_was_insufficient.wrong_moment: Register and memory snapshots were taken at CPU time mid-frame, never at the moment the raster crossed the capsule's scanlines.

method.beam_sampling: MEMORY_mem[0x3b00+ypos] is sampled on the first opcode of each ANTIC scanline, so the value recorded is the one ANTIC DMA fetches for that line.
method.pixel_oracle: Differential, not colour-assuming: full 384-pixel Screen_atari rows covering the capsule window are dumped run-length encoded after a complete ANTIC pass and compared against the same window without an active capsule. The value 70 ($46) was read out of the data, never asserted into it.
method.per_missile_decode: Each row byte is decoded as four separate two-bit missiles instead of masked with 0xf0.

root_cause.mechanism: clear_fighter_pickup_pmg ran from entity_effects_erase immediately after the frame gate (beam at scanline ~16), while render_fighter_pickup_pmg ran mid-frame from entity_effects_update, after world_ring_playfield. ANTIC fetches one missile byte per scanline, so for every capsule row above the re-render point the plane held zeroes when the beam arrived.
root_cause.evidence: Across 8 consecutive ACTIVE frames: rows with missile bits AT BEAM CROSSING 0/16, rows AT FRAME END 16/16, framebuffer histogram 0:7680 (pure background).
root_cause.why_collectable: Collection is an AABB test on logical X/Y and is independent of the missile plane, so the pickup stayed fully functional while invisible.
root_cause.registers_were_never_at_fault: HPOSM=[94,96,98,100], SIZEM=$00, PRIOR=$10, GRACTL=$03, DMACTL=$3E, COLPF3=$46, COLBK=$00 - all correct and stable throughout.

secondary_defect.mechanism: fighter_pickup_pmg_shape treated the low nibble as 'inert transport entropy'. Decoded per missile, only 2 of 16 rows set the full quartet: $FC gives M0=%00, $F1 gives M1=%00. The capsule's left edge was ragged.
secondary_defect.masked_by: The primary raster defect made the capsule invisible regardless, and the 0xf0 gate could not see M0/M1.

isolated_experiments.note: One variable per build, per owner instruction. Pixel counts are COLPF3 pixels inside the capsule window; 14 of 16 rows overlap the sampling reference because publication now lands one frame ahead, which is the intended behaviour.

fix.c_changes: none - the root cause is hardware publication, so no gameplay policy was migrated
asm_changes: entity_effects_erase no longer erases the missile plane at frame start
update_fighter_pickup_pmg keeps movement, collection and booster policy and tail-calls update_weapon_pickup_active; it no longer publishes
new publish_fighter_pickup_pmg erases and redraws the plane, falling through into render_fighter_pickup_pmg
publish_fighter_pickup_pmg is called from the existing post-playfield window after wait_frame_at_line $77, the same window that already publishes PairShots and the Light Wingman
fighter_pickup_pmg_shape is now 16 rows of $FF, a genuinely solid quartet
fix.harness_change: the native visibility gate now requires MEMORY_mem[0x3b00+row] == 0xff instead of a high-nibble mask

tests.added: tests/pickup-pmg-raster-visibility.test.mjs - asserts WHEN the plane is published and that every row sets the full M0-M3 quartet
tests.updated: tests/cold-pickup-record-fit.test.mjs and tests/light-wingman.test.mjs exact-size and window-order contracts now track the moved publication
tests.focused_run: 37 pass, 3 fail; all three failures are pre-existing at the baseline with identical names

next_step: Owner smoke. If it passes, the next task is the persistent Raider-coloured residual artifact; roadmap 4.3 and the Interceptor stay paused.
